name: Exact Repaired Match Word Count Step
overview: Tallies word counts for the text units whose leveraged top match was categorised as `EXACT_REPAIRED` — text and codes that match exactly only after some automated repair was applied to the candidate (for example number replacement, code repair, capitalisation, or punctuation adjustment). It reads the `AltTranslationsAnnotation` left by a leveraging step and, for each target segment or text container whose highest-ranked match is of this type, counts the words in the corresponding source. The counts are stored as `EXACT_REPAIRED` metrics annotations on the segment, text container, and aggregate resources, and consumed downstream by the Scoping Report Step. This is the word-count variant; the character-count variant counts characters instead of words.
processingNotes: Operates on the categorised top match only — the first entry of each segment's `AltTranslationsAnnotation` must have match type `EXACT_REPAIRED`.
Counts are computed over the source content; only translatable text units are counted.
Where a category group ranks several matches, the `CategoryResolver` keeps only the highest-ranked category and removes lower-ranked overlapping counts so totals are not double-counted.
